timing: Completed batches; samples are batch wall time / steps, quantiles are batch-average quantiles, mean is step-weighted; no rendering

quality.scope: Floor every step; independent swept candidates and exact box/sphere overlap; contact target requires both ≤1%
quality.resting: rest-stack/rest-grid only: at least 10 measured seconds, floor and pair depth ≤1%, center drift from lead-in endpoint ≤1%; not overall accuracy
quality.finalWindow: Last options.finalWindow measured steps only (worst-over-window fields unchanged): max and p95 over those steps of each step's worst floor and pair depth; max speed and kinetic energy; fraction of bodies below 0.01 m/s on the last step; settled = contact target on every window step and max speed ≤ 0.05 m/s
quality.replay: Per-step counter/state validation; timed final snapshot must match replay exactly

limitations: Dense diagnostic candidate searches can be quadratic; analytic trajectories cover only named diagnostic cases
Timeout checked between batches/steps; cannot interrupt a blocked synchronous step or diagnostic
No portable peak-memory measurement; capacities recorded
Pipelined batch averages are not frame latency

processMemory.scope: Process high-water RSS and final JS/external memory; includes harness and all selected engines, not GPU allocation or per-engine peak
